overview:
This check monitors the [Datadog Operator][1] through the Datadog Agent.

**Minimum Agent version:** 7.43.2

[1]: https://docs.datadoghq.com/containers/datadog_operator/
setup:
### Installation

Please see the documentation for [Datadog Operator][1].

[1]: https://docs.datadoghq.com/containers/datadog_operator/

metrics.name: datadog.operator.admission_controller.feature.enabled
metrics.description: `1` if the Admission Controller feature is enabled

metrics.name: datadog.operator.agent.deployment.success
metrics.description: `1` if the desired number of Agent replicas equals the number of available Agent pods. `0` otherwise.

metrics.name: datadog.operator.workqueue_work_duration_seconds.sum
